settings.title: Sign-in & registration
settings.description: Configure how users register and how email verification works.
settings.emailGroupHint: Users create an account with an email address and password.
settings.emailVerificationHint: When enabled, users must enter the code sent to their inbox before registration completes.
settings.emailVerificationUnavailable: No email verification code plugin is available. Configure one under “SMTP mail” first.
settings.phoneGroupHint: Requires an SMS verification plugin, which is not available yet.
settings.registrationHint: When off, the sign-up entry point is hidden and every registration request is refused. Existing users are unaffected.
settings.emailVerificationBlocked: Email verification is on, but no code can be delivered right now: registration will be refused. Install and configure SMTP mail first, or turn this off.
settings.methodLocked: Phone sign-up is not available yet, so email is the only registration method.
